| # Flashing steps for signed HEX files {#flashing-steps-for-signed-hex-files-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                        |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 \
 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   These steps are only required for CRA compliant users.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------

 

Step 1: Flash CB-ME  V03.11.00 or higher using BDS Flashing Tool configuring the argument SELECT_BLOCK_NAME as CB.

Step 2: Flash KEYFILE using BDS Flashing Tool configuring the argument SELECT_BLOCK_NAME as KEYFILE.

Step 3 (Optional): Flash signed CB-ME using BDS Flashing Tool configuring the argument SELECT_BLOCK_NAME as CB.

Step 4: Flash signed ASW+DS0 using BDS Flashing Tool configuring the argument SELECT_BLOCK_NAME as ASW.

 

 \
